{{for|{{Wow-inline}} Classic events|Events/Classic}}
{{for|EventRegistry callback events|EventRegistry}}
'''Frame Events''' are messages sent by the WoW client to UI code (via {{api|t=wh|OnEvent}} script handlers), mostly in reaction to things occurring in the game world. For a general tutorial on setting up event handling in your addon, see [[Handling events]] and the {{api|t=w|Frame:RegisterEvent}}() method.

<big>'''Event Trace'''</big>
: The Event Trace window for debugging events can be opened via the <code>[[MACRO_eventtrace|/etrace]]</code> slash command. 

[[File:MACRO_eventtrace_01.png|577px|link=|border]]

<big>'''Example'''</big>
: Shows when a chat channel message appears and when you start/stop moving.
<syntaxhighlight lang="lua">
local function OnEvent(self, event, ...)
	print(event, ...)
end

local f = CreateFrame("Frame")
f:RegisterEvent("CHAT_MSG_CHANNEL")
f:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_STARTED_MOVING")
f:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_STOPPED_MOVING")
f:SetScript("OnEvent", OnEvent)
</syntaxhighlight>
